newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil to spud 2 wells in Norwegian Sea.
newsitem.headline: Statoil to spud 2 wells in Norwegian Sea.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it planned to drill two wells in production licence 200 north of the Norne field in the Norwegian Sea before end-February to test new geological models.
The wells mark an expansion in drilling in the Norne area, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.

The Transocean 8 rig, owned by Transocean Offshore Inc, will spud exploration well 6608/8-1 in mid-January and is due to start drilling the 6608/8-2 well during February. The two new exploration models are shallow and deep respectively, the company said.
Extensive three-dimensional surveys have already been carried out on the acreage, which was awarded in Norway's 14th licensing round in 1993.
